_finding: simulate_buy's answer is facts, never advice, and never a number made up (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §0.1, §3.3, §7): a look-alike gets no quote, a Robinhood token (minted: null) is answered, a missing pause flag is not 'not paused', a zero quote is no price, the premium follows peg.mjs's refusals and `within` the reference's state both ways round, and no text we do not control or word of advice enters the lead.

mutations.name: an impostor is assembled with a quote
mutations.find: amount_in: amountIn, quote: null, premium: null,
mutations.replace: amount_in: amountIn, quote: quoteBlock(quote, { decimals, usd: input.usd, slippageBps: input.slippageBps, now }), premium: null,
mutations.expect: FAIL an impostor gets no quote

mutations.name: minted !== true refuses
mutations.expect: FAIL a Robinhood token is answered

mutations.name: a missing paused is read as not paused
mutations.expect: FAIL paused_unknown

mutations.name: the amountOut > 0 guard is removed
mutations.expect: FAIL amountOut "0" is quote_empty

mutations.name: the spread refusal is removed
mutations.expect: FAIL a reference spread above MAX_REFERENCE_SPREAD

mutations.name: within is set from a held reference
mutations.expect: FAIL within is null for a held reference

mutations.name: within is set from a reference of unknown age
mutations.expect: FAIL within is null for a reference whose age is unknown

mutations.name: within (float) compares the signed premium
mutations.find: export const withinLimit = (premium, limit) => Math.abs(premium) <= limit
mutations.replace: export const withinLimit = (premium, limit) => premium <= limit
mutations.expect: FAIL the edge: exactly the limit is within

mutations.name: a revert reason is put into the lead
mutations.find: ${REVERT_WORDS[sim.revert?.kind] || 'for a reason we could not attribute'}
mutations.replace: ${sim.revert?.reason || REVERT_WORDS[sim.revert?.kind] || 'for a reason we could not attribute'}
mutations.expect: FAIL text we do not control stays out of our sentence

mutations.name: a pool label is put into the lead
mutations.expect: FAIL text we do not control stays out of our sentence

mutations.name: the multiplier is applied to the reference
mutations.expect: FAIL the effective premium is the effective price over the reference, and no multiplier is applied

mutations.name: the plausibility ratio is skipped
mutations.find:
if (!(ratio > 0) || ratio > MAX_PLAUSIBLE_RATIO || ratio < 1 / MAX_PLAUSIBLE_RATIO) out.premium_refused = 'implausible_vs_reference'
    else out.effective_premium = ratio - 1
mutations.expect: FAIL a 5x quote is not a premium

mutations.name: within compares with < at the edge
mutations.expect: FAIL the edge: exactly the limit is within

mutations.name: the default limit is changed
mutations.expect: FAIL defaults:

mutations.name: a banned word is put into the lead
mutations.find: const tail = 'Facts with their time and source, not advice.'
mutations.replace: const tail = 'Facts with their time and source: a good deal.'
mutations.expect: FAIL no advice words in any lead

mutations.name: the look-alike's own symbol is used in the lead
mutations.replace: return `${v.symbol || v.address} is not on ${who}'s list
mutations.expect: FAIL creator's text stays out of our sentence

mutations.name: within (exact) compares the signed premium
mutations.expect: FAIL a discount past the limit is outside too

mutations.name: within (exact) excludes the edge
mutations.expect: FAIL an assembled quote at exactly +3% and -3%

mutations.name: the exact comparison is not used
mutations.find: return x == null ? { ...o, within_refused: 'no_premium' } : { ...o, within: x }
mutations.expect: FAIL an assembled quote at exactly +3% and -3%

mutations.name: the pause is read from the passport's reading
mutations.expect: FAIL the pause is read from the issuer's snapshot now

mutations.name: an exponent limit falls back to float
mutations.expect: FAIL exact for any limit, an exponent included
